description: This file defines the DiagnosisAttribute class, which represents an attribute associated with a Diagnosis in the OpenMRS medical record system. It extends the BaseAttribute class and includes fields and methods to manage diagnosis-specific attribute data, including getter and setter methods for diagnosis ownership and attribute ID.

classes.name: DiagnosisAttribute
classes.description: Represents a diagnosis-related attribute, extending BaseAttribute with specific methods for diagnosis association and ID management.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeId
methods.description: Returns the identifier for this DiagnosisAttribute instance.

methods.name: setDiagnosisAttributeId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for this DiagnosisAttribute instance.

methods.name: getDiagnosis
methods.description: Retrieves the Diagnosis object associated with this attribute.

methods.name: setDiagnosis
methods.description: Associates a Diagnosis object with this attribute.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides to return the diagnosis attribute ID, fulfilling the OpenMRS object contract.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides to set the diagnosis attribute ID, fulfilling the OpenMRS object contract.
